svg.title: Development process: tools and commands
svg.desc: Five steps from the start over MCU firmware, optional FPGA design, API and test to the release. Each step lists the commands, the tools with their license, what has to be adapted and the result. The loop measure, adapt, repeat leads from the test back to the firmware.
